title: perf: skip await on order.save() to avoid blocking
description: Small perf tweak — order creation returned the id before persistence completed anyway, so awaiting save() is unnecessary overhead. Makes the endpoint faster.
notes: Removes the await on order.save(). Bug: order.id may not be populated (depending on ORM behavior), any DB error becomes an unhandled promise rejection, and callers assume the order is persisted when it isn't. One expected finding.
